func numeric_less<t>(const left: t, const right: t) -> bool:
    var zero: t = 0
    if left != left:
        return false
    if right != right:
        return true
    return left < right
func order_probe<t>(const items: [t], less: func(const t, const t) -> bool, descending: bool = false) -> bool:
    if items.count < 2:
        return false
    if descending:
        return less(items[1], items[0])
    return less(items[0], items[1])
func main():
    var left_i8: i8 = 1
    var right_i8: i8 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_i8, right_i8))
    var left_u8: u8 = 1
    var right_u8: u8 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_u8, right_u8))
    var left_i16: i16 = 1
    var right_i16: i16 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_i16, right_i16))
    var left_u16: u16 = 1
    var right_u16: u16 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_u16, right_u16))
    var left_i32: i32 = 1
    var right_i32: i32 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_i32, right_i32))
    var left_u32: u32 = 1
    var right_u32: u32 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_u32, right_u32))
    var left_i64: i64 = 1
    var right_i64: i64 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_i64, right_i64))
    var left_u64: u64 = 1
    var right_u64: u64 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_u64, right_u64))
    var left_f32: f32 = 1
    var right_f32: f32 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_f32, right_f32))
    var left_f64: f64 = 1
    var right_f64: f64 = 2
    print(numeric_less(left_f64, right_f64))
